name: Microsoft Bookings
description: Microsoft Bookings is an appointment scheduling app, included with Microsoft 365, that lets organizations create online booking pages synced with Outlook calendars.
best_for: Microsoft 365 organizations in financial services, healthcare, and education that want appointment booking built into their existing Outlook and Teams environment.
features: Real-time sync with Outlook calendars to prevent double-booking
Staff scheduling with multiple service providers per appointment type
Automated confirmation emails and calendar invitations

alternatives.name: Calendly
alternatives.description: A scheduling tool that lets people share availability links to book meetings without back-and-forth emails.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals and teams booking one-off or recurring meetings

alternatives.name: Acuity Scheduling
alternatives.description: An online appointment booking platform with branded booking pages, payments, and reminders.

alternatives.name: Setmore
alternatives.description: A free online appointment scheduling platform with booking pages, payments, and reminders.
alternatives.best_for: Small service businesses wanting a free booking solution
